title: API Gateway Dashboard (Korean)
prompt:
A calm, restrained operations dashboard for a developer infrastructure tool — an API gateway that pools multiple API keys and mirrors generated UI screens locally. Korean interface.

AESTHETIC — "quiet operations console". This is the opposite of a neon/gradient admin template:
- Exactly two neutrals plus ONE single accent colour. The accent appears only on live status and the one primary action per screen. Never two accents competing.
- NO card borders and NO rounded boxes-inside-boxes. Separate sections with hairline 1px rules and generous vertical whitespace instead.
- No drop shadows, no glows, no gradient fills, no glassmorphism.
- Numbers are large and quiet; their labels are small, uppercase-tracked, and low-contrast. The eye should land on the number first.
- Light theme: warm off-white paper, near-black ink, one deep accent.

LAYOUT — a 240px left sidebar with a plain vertical nav (9 items, one active with a subtle left rule and weight change, not a filled pill), a slim top bar with the product name on the left and three small live status readouts on the right, and a wide content column.

CONTENT — the page is a gateway overview in Korean:
- A row of four key figures separated by vertical hairlines rather than cards: "가용 API 키 풀" 1/1, "누적 MCP 호출" 25, "로컬 영속 스크린" 5, "성공률" 48%.
- Below a hairline, a two-column region: on the left "최근 생성된 화면" as a plain list of five rows, each with a title, a small muted timestamp on the right, and nothing else. On the right "실시간 트래픽 스트림" as a monospace log list with a small level dot, a muted timestamp, and one line of text per entry.
- A single primary button at the top right of the content area.

TYPOGRAPHY — a distinctive serif or grotesk for headings and figures, and a separate restrained sans for body and labels; a true monospace with tabular figures for logs, IDs and all numeric columns. Korean text must never break mid-word.

Deliberately avoid: purple/blue SaaS gradients, emoji used as icons, coloured pill badges everywhere, cards nested inside cards, and any decoration that does not carry information.
